capabilities.title: Fail-closed action authorization
capabilities.description: Evaluates every proposed real-world action against an ordered policy pipeline and returns ALLOW, REQUIRES_APPROVAL, or DENY. Denies by default, denies on error, and cannot itself perform an action.

capabilities.title: Scoped, expiring human approval
capabilities.description: Issues HMAC-signed approval tokens bound to one action type, one target digest, and one expiry window, so that an approval cannot be forged by the agent runtime or replayed against a different target.

capabilities.title: Do-not-contact enforcement
capabilities.description: Normalizes contact identifiers and checks them against a keyed-digest suppression list. Stores no raw phone number or email address, so a leaked suppression file cannot be reused as a contact list.

capabilities.title: Credential and PII redaction on egress
capabilities.description: Scans outbound content for credential shapes and personal data before it reaches a third party, a log, or a model prompt. Findings report detector names and offsets only, never the matched value.

capabilities.title: Structural test/production state isolation
capabilities.description: Refuses to hand a non-test database target to a process that has identified itself as a test runner. Allowlist-shaped, so an unrecognized target fails closed rather than slipping through an outdated pattern.

capabilities.title: Evidence-state ladder
capabilities.description: Resolves the highest state a subject has earned from an unbroken chain of evidence, and refuses to support a claim beyond it. Runtime evidence expires; source evidence does not.

capabilities.title: Evidence-gated release verdict
capabilities.description: Validates the capability and claim registries against their schemas, checks every active claim against the evidence ledger, and emits a verdict with a machine-readable report. Distinguishes policy verdicts from its own execution failure by exit code.

capabilities.title: Change-scoped merge policy
capabilities.description: Combines the release-gate verdict with the set of files a change touched to produce a merge decision, so that advisory findings escalate on governed surface and a safety-critical change without a test change is blocked.
